cards.concept: Order-flow imbalance can explain short-horizon price changes
cards.definition_principle: In the cited limit-order-book study, short-interval price changes related more strongly to order-flow imbalance across limit, market, and cancellation events than to trade imbalance alone.
measurable_predicates: best bid/ask event stream is complete
limit additions, cancellations, and trades are signed
required_evidence: authoritative L2 or top-of-book event history
valid_conditions: The exact OFI definition and event completeness policy are implemented.
failure_conditions: Only candle volume, OI, or trade prints are available.
contradictions: CITADEL currently lacks production-authoritative L2 order-event history for this predicate.
when_not_to_use: Do not approximate OFI with volume, OI, CVD, or candle color.
cards.exact_locator: Section 4.1 > Trade imbalance vs order flow imbalance
cards.short_excerpt: order flow imbalance explains price movements better than the imbalance of trades
cards.paraphrase: Keep OFI future-data-dependent until complete order events exist; never substitute lower-quality proxies.

cards.definition_principle: The cited model found the price-impact slope inversely related to market depth, so liquidity state belongs in any executable-quality explanation.
measurable_predicates: depth units and levels are declared
valid_conditions: Depth is authoritative and sufficiently complete.
failure_conditions: Depth is missing, stale, or only a single unverified display value.
contradictions: A deep displayed book may change or cancel; depth does not guarantee fill.
when_not_to_use: Do not infer execution quality from spread alone when size/depth is unavailable.
cards.short_excerpt: a slope inversely proportional to the market depth
cards.paraphrase: Include fresh depth and completeness in liquidity explanations while preserving fill uncertainty.

cards.definition_principle: Traded volume omits limit-order additions and cancellations; it must not be relabeled as OFI or institutional flow.
measurable_predicates: input lineage distinguishes trades from quote events
valid_conditions: Volume is described only as volume.
failure_conditions: Volume, OI, or CVD is renamed OFI.
contradictions: The cited paper found volume-based relations noisier and less robust than OFI.
when_not_to_use: Do not infer aggressive buyer/seller intent from aggregate volume alone.
cards.short_excerpt: trade volume is found to be noisy and less robust
cards.paraphrase: Preserve semantic separation among volume, OI, trade imbalance, and full OFI.

cards.concept: Displayed liquidity does not guarantee execution
cards.definition_principle: Order-book evidence is conditional and dynamic; displayed depth supports an execution-quality estimate but cannot be reported as a fill.
measurable_predicates: submitted quantity is compared with available depth
fills come only from paper/broker events
valid_conditions: Analysis, submission, and fill truth remain separate.
failure_conditions: A quote or depth snapshot is reported as filled quantity.
contradictions: Orders may be cancelled or consumed before simulated or real execution.
when_not_to_use: Do not claim broker-style fill certainty from a market-data snapshot.
cards.paraphrase: Use depth as bounded evidence and reserve fill truth for immutable execution events.
